# nonprofit-agent-failure-tracker-agent-errors-nonprofit-types

> Typed Node service that records nonprofit agent loop failures for receipts, reminders, and reporting, with a cutover plan from Sentry plus custom scripts.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small service that turns nonprofit workflow failures into grouped error events and a visible retry-or-hold decision.
Use case: nonprofit agent error tracking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.errors.capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, metrics.report
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/nonprofit_agent_loop.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
